name: pf-desktop
description: PromptForge desktop app (macOS + Windows) — Electron shell hosting the builder, enhance, tray, and floating widget.

scripts.build:main: esbuild src/main/index.ts src/preload/index.ts src/preload/widget.ts src/main/tray.ts src/main/widget.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.js --entry-names=[dir]/[name]
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:assets && npm run build:renderer
